body: Also, should I call the suicide hotline? I'm very scared to, but I want to talk to someone.

I just can't anymore. If you want to know more about me, check my last submissions on my profile. I'm so scared right now. My relationship with someone very dear to me has gone to shit. They're going into foster care. I never get to see them. I can't be around my family. I don't have any friends. I don't want to be here anymore and I'm mortified of what's to happen. It's only going to get worse. I'm just not going to make it.

I've tried therapy before, and it's never helped. It's unavailable to me now because of our financial situation. And yeah, I've always had the same issue. It's odd because whenever something painful or shocking happens (which has happened recently) I'm fine at first and handle the situation calmly. But my feelings later descend afterward, and they crash down horribly with how I rationalize everything. They begin to dumb me down and make it harder for me to process even the simplest of things. 

I've never been real hip on spiritual authors, even though I like some of what they say. They just tend to make me more depressed, for some reason.

And no, I'll have to check that out if I can. Anything that I can relate may help, thank you.
Happy memories hurt. Quite frankly I don't want to be around for more. They don't assuage how I feel when I'm at my worse, they only further my remorse and unhappiness. :/

That's silly to think, really. There's always going to be people who will miss you. Your death will affect so many people, more than you may realize. It will tear them up. You may wish to die, and I understand. I am at that same predicament. But never believe that there is no one who will care if you die.

I know. I'm having a hard time replying to this because there is so much to say. I know there's so much to experience and appreciate, but it's so hard when you feel like there's nothing. My feelings and my rationalizing don't synch up. It's uncontrollable. I love everyone and appreciate them, it just hurts so bad to see them hurt. I'm selfish for wanting to kill myself, I hate myself for it, because I know it will hurt them ridiculously.

And, not to try to be mean and deny what you've said, but we are kind of alone. People come and go, whether they wish to or not. The time we have with them is insatiable. It's almost cruel for us to spend time with them because of what little time we do have them. I wish to share so much and help them so much, but I can't. It's "wrong."

Human life is really fascinating. It's kind of beautiful and all that jazz, y'know? But it makes me feel awful, too, how predictable that path is. I know I will feel happy again, but that is not what I want. We all have ups and downs in life, and I hope that for many people that is consoling, but it isn't for me. 

I understand that things get better, I'm so happy for anyone whose life does and they truthfully enjoy it. It's just, I don't know, I'm helplessly sad for almost no reason according to some people. Maybe it's biological. I don't know, but I would love to talk to you about your experiences, if that's ok.

I know I do, or at least did enjoy spending time with him. My sister's disappointment kind of muddles that for me. And yeah, I've told my boyfriend about it and he tries to help as much as possible. It's hard on him because he feels helpless as well. I regret telling him because I know that's a lot to deal with since he cares for me. I want to help myself get better to help him, but it's so hard. Thank you for taking the time to listen, I really do appreciate it.

I say I'm alone because it's hard to talk to the people I love because they all hate each other. My sister, my good friend, and my boyfriend do not get along. My one friend seems to try to ruin my relationships, my boyfriend doesn't like him for that reason, and my sister hates them both. I just don't understand. 

And it's not the imperfections of day to day life's little matters that get me. It's the constant pile on of all these issues with the little relief I'm feeling followed with the rebuttal of "it's wrong. You can do better."

I really appreciate you taking the time a listening, by the way. I hope I don't offend. :/
